ingredient_list_two_servings: 350g chicken breast;2 peppers;1 onion;4 tortillas;1 tsp smoked paprika;1 tsp cumin;1 lime;1 tbsp oil
original_cooking_instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables. Toss with oil and spices. Roast at 210C for 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Warm tortillas and serve with lime.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 400g chicken thighs;400g baby potatoes;150g cherry tomatoes;1 red onion;1 lemon;2 garlic cloves;1 tsp oregano;1 tbsp oil
original_cooking_instructions: Halve potatoes and onion; toss with oil, lemon, garlic and oregano. Roast with chicken at 200C for 35-45 minutes. Add tomatoes for final 15 minutes. Check chicken is cooked through.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g chicken breast;180g pasta;100g spinach;1 pepper;120ml single cream;2 tsp Cajun seasoning;1 garlic clove
original_cooking_instructions: Cook pasta. Brown sliced seasoned chicken; add pepper and garlic. Stir in cream and a splash of pasta water, simmer until chicken is cooked. Fold through spinach and pasta.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 400g chicken thighs;140g jasmine rice;50ml soy sauce;45ml vinegar;3 garlic cloves;2 bay leaves;1 tsp brown sugar;180g green beans
original_cooking_instructions: Brown chicken. Add garlic, soy, vinegar, bay leaves, sugar and 100ml water. Cover and simmer 25-30 minutes until cooked; reduce sauce. Cook rice and steam beans.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g chicken breast;140g jasmine rice;1 egg;70g breadcrumbs;1 onion;2 carrots;1 tbsp curry powder;250ml chicken stock;1 tbsp flour
original_cooking_instructions: Coat flattened chicken in egg and breadcrumbs; shallow-fry until golden and cooked. Soften onion and carrot, add flour and curry powder, whisk in stock and simmer. Serve sliced chicken with rice and curry sauce.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g chicken mince;140g jasmine rice;180g green beans;3 garlic cloves;1 chilli;20ml soy sauce;1 tbsp oyster sauce;15g basil
original_cooking_instructions: Cook rice. Stir-fry mince until browned; add garlic, chilli and beans. Add sauces with a splash of water; cook until beans are tender and chicken is cooked. Fold in basil.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 350g chicken thigh;2 flatbreads;100g yoghurt;1 cucumber;2 tomatoes;1 tsp cumin;1 tsp paprika;1 lemon;1 garlic clove
original_cooking_instructions: Coat sliced chicken with spices, lemon and half the yoghurt. Pan-fry until browned and cooked. Mix remaining yoghurt with garlic; fill warm flatbreads with chicken, chopped cucumber and tomato.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g beef mince;450g potatoes;1 onion;2 carrots;120g peas;1 tbsp tomato puree;250ml beef stock;20g butter
original_cooking_instructions: Brown beef with onion and carrot. Add tomato puree and stock; simmer 15 minutes, then peas. Boil and mash potatoes with butter. Top beef and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g thin beef strips;140g jasmine rice;1 cucumber;1 carrot;30ml soy sauce;1 tbsp brown sugar;1 tsp sesame oil;2 garlic cloves;10g ginger
original_cooking_instructions: Cook rice. Mix soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger; marinate beef briefly. Sear beef in a hot pan until cooked. Serve over rice with julienned carrot and cucumber.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g beef strips;180g egg noodles;250g broccoli;2 garlic cloves;20ml soy sauce;30g hoisin;1 tsp cornflour;10g ginger
original_cooking_instructions: Cook noodles. Sear beef and set aside. Stir-fry broccoli, ginger and garlic; add sauces and cornflour mixed with water. Return beef, toss with noodles and heat through.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g beef mince;2 large potatoes;1 onion;1 tin kidney beans;1 tin chopped tomatoes;1 tsp cumin;1 tsp smoked paprika;1 chilli
original_cooking_instructions: Bake potatoes at 200C for 50-60 minutes. Brown mince and onion; add spices, beans and tomatoes. Simmer 25 minutes and spoon over split potatoes.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g beef mince;180g spaghetti;1 egg;30g breadcrumbs;1 onion;400g chopped tomatoes;2 garlic cloves;1 tsp oregano
original_cooking_instructions: Mix mince, egg and breadcrumbs; shape balls and brown. Simmer in tomatoes, garlic, onion and oregano for 20 minutes until cooked. Serve with spaghetti.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g lamb mince;2 pittas;1 tsp cumin;1 tsp coriander;1 garlic clove;100g yoghurt;1 cucumber;2 tomatoes;1 lemon
original_cooking_instructions: Mix lamb with spices and garlic; form koftas. Grill or pan-fry until cooked. Mix yoghurt with lemon and diced cucumber; serve in warm pittas with tomato.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g diced lamb;1 tin chickpeas;150g couscous;2 carrots;1 onion;1 tin chopped tomatoes;1 tsp cumin;1 tsp cinnamon;300ml stock
original_cooking_instructions: Brown lamb and onion, add spices, carrots, tomatoes and stock. Cover and simmer 60-90 minutes until tender; add chickpeas for final 15 minutes. Hydrate couscous and serve.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 250g paneer;140g basmati rice;1 pepper;1 red onion;120g yoghurt;1 tsp garam masala;1 tsp paprika;1 lemon;10g mint
original_cooking_instructions: Toss paneer and vegetables with half the yoghurt and spices. Roast at 210C for 20 minutes, turning once. Cook rice; combine remaining yoghurt with mint and lemon.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 2 tins chickpeas;140g basmati rice;1 onion;1 tin chopped tomatoes;2 garlic cloves;10g ginger;1 tsp garam masala;1 tsp cumin;100g spinach
original_cooking_instructions: Cook rice. Soften onion, garlic and ginger with spices. Add tomatoes and drained chickpeas; simmer 20 minutes. Stir through spinach until wilted.

recipe_name: Sweet potato and black bean enchiladas
ingredient_list_two_servings: 450g sweet potatoes;1 tin black beans;4 tortillas;300g passata;100g cheddar;1 onion;1 tsp cumin;1 tsp paprika
original_cooking_instructions: Roast cubed sweet potato at 200C for 20 minutes. Mix with beans, onion and spices; roll in tortillas. Cover with passata and cheese; bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 180g pasta;200g ricotta;200g spinach;300g passata;80g mozzarella;2 garlic cloves;1 tsp oregano
original_cooking_instructions: Cook pasta until slightly firm. Wilt spinach with garlic, mix with ricotta and pasta. Layer with passata and mozzarella; bake at 200C for 20-25 minutes.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 350g mushrooms;180g egg noodles;1 onion;150g sour cream;1 tsp mustard;200ml vegetable stock;1 tsp paprika;1 tbsp flour
original_cooking_instructions: Cook noodles. Brown mushrooms and onion, add paprika and flour. Stir in stock and simmer 5 minutes; turn heat low and stir in sour cream and mustard. Serve over noodles.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g firm tofu;140g jasmine rice;200g broccoli;1 pepper;20ml soy sauce;1 tbsp hoisin;1 tsp sesame oil;2 garlic cloves
original_cooking_instructions: Cook rice. Pat tofu dry, cube and fry until golden. Stir-fry broccoli and pepper, add garlic and sauces; return tofu and toss to coat.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 2 salmon fillets (260g);400g baby potatoes;200g green beans;1 lemon;1 garlic clove;1 tbsp olive oil;1 tsp dried dill
original_cooking_instructions: Roast halved potatoes at 200C for 25 minutes. Add salmon with lemon, garlic and dill for 12-15 minutes until cooked; steam beans separately.

recipe_name: Cod in tomato and olive sauce
ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g cod fillets;140g couscous;1 courgette;300g passata;50g olives;2 garlic cloves;1 tsp oregano;1 tbsp olive oil
original_cooking_instructions: Soften sliced courgette and garlic in oil; add passata, olives and oregano. Nestle cod in sauce, cover and simmer gently 8-12 minutes until opaque and cooked. Prepare couscous.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g raw peeled prawns;140g jasmine rice;200ml coconut milk;1 pepper;100g mangetout;1 tbsp Thai red curry paste;1 lime
original_cooking_instructions: Cook rice. Fry curry paste briefly, add coconut milk and sliced pepper; simmer 8 minutes. Add prawns and mangetout, cook until prawns turn pink and opaque; finish with lime.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 2 large potatoes;1 tin tuna (145g drained);120g sweetcorn;60g mayonnaise;40g cheddar;1 cucumber;1 tomato
original_cooking_instructions: Bake potatoes at 200C for 50-60 minutes until tender. Mix drained tuna, sweetcorn and mayonnaise. Split potatoes, fill and top with cheese; serve with cucumber and tomato.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 225g halloumi;150g couscous;1 courgette;1 pepper;1 red onion;1 lemon;1 tsp oregano;1 tbsp oil
original_cooking_instructions: Roast chopped vegetables with oil and oregano at 210C for 25 minutes. Pan-fry sliced halloumi until golden. Prepare couscous; combine with vegetables and lemon, top with halloumi.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 1 tin lentils;450g potatoes;1 onion;2 carrots;120g peas;200ml vegetable stock;1 tbsp tomato puree;20g butter
original_cooking_instructions: Soften onion and carrot; add lentils, tomato puree, stock and peas. Simmer until thick. Boil and mash potatoes with butter, spread over filling and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 250g beef mince;1 aubergine;120g bulgur;1 onion;250g chopped tomatoes;2 garlic cloves;1 tsp cumin;1 tbsp olive oil
original_cooking_instructions: Halve and score aubergine, roast at 200C for 25 minutes. Brown beef with onion, garlic and cumin; add tomatoes and simmer. Spoon over aubergine and bake 15 minutes more. Serve with bulgur.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 160g orzo;1 tin chickpeas;100g spinach;1 lemon;1 onion;2 garlic cloves;400ml vegetable stock;50g feta
original_cooking_instructions: Soften onion and garlic, add orzo and stock; simmer stirring until nearly tender. Add drained chickpeas and spinach, cook until orzo is done. Finish with lemon and crumbled feta.

ingredient_list_two_servings: 300g chicken thigh;160g rice noodles;1 cucumber;1 carrot;1 stalk lemongrass;1 lime;1 tbsp fish sauce;1 tsp sugar;2 garlic cloves
original_cooking_instructions: Marinate sliced chicken with minced lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce and sugar. Cook noodles, rinse and drain. Fry chicken until cooked; serve with shredded vegetables and lime.

recipe_name: Indian red lentil dal with roast cauliflower
ingredient_list_two_servings: 180g red lentils;140g basmati rice;1 small cauliflower;1 onion;1 tin chopped tomatoes;1 tsp turmeric;1 tsp cumin;2 garlic cloves;1 tbsp oil
original_cooking_instructions: Roast cauliflower with oil and cumin at 210C for 25 minutes. Simmer lentils with onion, garlic, tomatoes, turmeric and 450ml water until soft, 20-25 minutes. Serve with cooked rice.
